claims: A new live-action Harry Potter TV series is set to premiere on HBO and Max on Christmas 2026.
The Harry Potter TV series will feature an entirely new cast.
The Harry Potter TV series will feature Dominic McLaughlin as Harry.
The Harry Potter TV series will feature Arabella Stanton as Hermione.
The Harry Potter TV series will feature Alastair Stout as Ron.
The first season of the Harry Potter TV series covers Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone.
The first season of the Harry Potter TV series debuts December 25, 2026.
The Harry Potter TV series features John Lithgow as Albus Dumbledore.
The Harry Potter TV series features Janet McTeer as Minerva McGonagall.
The Harry Potter TV series features Paapa Essiedu as Severus Snape.
The Craft Behind the Magic premieres on HBO/Max on April 5, 2026.
The Harry Potter TV series is produced with author J.K. Rowling acting as an executive producer
